import math

# Compile all the monthly outlay data from Jan 1984 to Mar 1987

    'Jan': 84, 'Feb': 89, 'Mar': 63, 'Apr': 74,
    'May': 62, 'June': 93, 'July': 65, 'Aug': 79,
    'Sept': 69, 'Oct': 79, 'Nov': 67, 'Dec': 96
}

# From 1986 bulletin (Jan 1985 - Dec 1985)
data_1985 = {
    'Jan': 66, 'Feb': 60, 'Mar': 59, 'Apr': 119,
    'May': 75, 'June': 63, 'July': 74, 'Aug': 103,
    'Sept': 66, 'Oct': 98, 'Nov': 74, 'Dec': 102
}

# From 1987 bulletin (Jan 1986 - Dec 1986)
data_1986 = {
    'Jan': 76, 'Feb': 109, 'Mar': 74, 'Apr': 129,
    'May': 75, 'June': 71, 'July': 70, 'Aug': 106,
    'Sept': 87, 'Oct': 73, 'Nov': 73, 'Dec': 113
}

# From 1988 bulletin (Jan 1987 - Mar 1987)
data_1987 = {
    'Jan': 79, 'Feb': 76, 'Mar': 110
}

# Combine all data (Jan 1984 to Mar 1987 = 39 months)
all_values = []

# 1984 (12 months)
for month in ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'Aug', 'Sept', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']:
    all_values.append(data_1984[month])

# 1985 (12 months)
for month in ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'Aug', 'Sept', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']:
    all_values.append(data_1985[month])

# 1986 (12 months)
for month in ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'Aug', 'Sept', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']:
    all_values.append(data_1986[month])

# 1987 (3 months: Jan, Feb, Mar)

    all_values.append(data_1987[month])

print(f"Number of months: {len(all_values)}")
print(f"All values: {all_values}")

# Calculate geometric mean
# GM = (v1 * v2 * ... * vn)^(1/n)
# Or equivalently: exp(sum(ln(vi)) / n)

log_sum = sum(math.log(v) for v in all_values)
geometric_mean = math.exp(log_sum / len(all_values))

print(f"\nLog sum: {log_sum}")
print(f"Geometric mean: {geometric_mean}")
print(f"Geometric mean (millions): {geometric_mean:.3f}")
